public class Solution {
    private static final long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE;
    
    private int r, c;
    private long[][] binom = new long[128][128];
    private long minDiff = INF;
    private char[] pattern;
    private int[] countA = new int[128], countB = new int[128];
    private Map<Long, Long> memo = new HashMap<>();

    private void initBinomial() {
        for (int i = 0; i < 128; i++) {
            binom[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                binom[i][j] = binom[i-1][j-1] + binom[i-1][j];
            }
        }
    }

    private long backtrack(long A, long B, int idxA, int idxB) {
        long diff = Math.abs(A - B);
        if (minDiff <= 1 || diff - binom[idxA][r]*binom[idxB][r] >= minDiff) return 0;
        if (idxA == r-1 && idxB == r-1) {
            if (diff < minDiff) minDiff = diff;
            return 1;
        }
        long total = 0;
        if (idxA >= r) {
            long diffA = binom[idxA][r] - binom[idxA-1][r], sumB = binom[idxB][r];
            total += backtrack(A, B + diffA*sumB, idxA-1, idxB);
        }
        if (idxB >= r) {
            long sumA = binom[idxA][r], diffB = binom[idxB][r] - binom[idxB-1][r];
            total += backtrack(A + sumA*diffB, B, idxA, idxB-1);
        }
        return total;
    }

    private long countPaths(long A, long B, int idxA, int idxB) {
        long state = ((A << 18) ^ (B << 6) ^ (idxA << 3) ^ idxB);
        if (memo.containsKey(state)) return memo.get(state);
        long diff = Math.abs(A - B);
        if (diff - binom[idxA][r]*binom[idxB][r] > minDiff) {
            memo.put(state, 0L);
            return 0;
        }
        if (idxA == 0 && idxB == 0) return 1;
        char cmd = pattern[idxA + idxB - 1];
        long result = 0;
        if (idxA > 0 && cmd != 'B') {
            long diffA = binom[idxA][r] - binom[idxA-1][r], sumB = binom[idxB][r];
            result += countPaths(A, B + diffA*sumB, idxA-1, idxB);
        }
        if (idxB > 0 && cmd != 'A') {
            long sumA = binom[idxA][r], diffB = binom[idxB][r] - binom[idxB-1][r];
            result += countPaths(A + sumA*diffB, B, idxA, idxB-1);
        }
        memo.put(state, result);
        return result;
    }

    private void run() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        r = sc.nextInt();
        c = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        pattern = sc.nextLine().toCharArray();
        initBinomial();
        int p1 = r + c, p2 = r + c;
        long left = 0, right = 0;
        while (p1 >= r && p2 >= r) {
            if (left > right) {
                long diff1 = binom[p1][r] - binom[p1-1][r], sum2 = binom[p2][r];
                right += diff1 * sum2;
                p1--;
            } else {
                long sum1 = binom[p1][r], diff2 = binom[p2][r] - binom[p2-1][r];
                left += sum1 * diff2;
                p2--;
            }
        }
        minDiff = Math.abs(left - right);
        backtrack(0, 0, r + c, r + c);
        for (int i = 0; i < 2*(r+c); i++) {
            countA[i+1] = countA[i] + (pattern[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            countB[i+1] = countB[i] + (pattern[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }
        long paths = countPaths(0, 0, r + c, r + c);
        System.out.println(paths);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Solution().run();
    }
}

        for (int i = 0; i < 130; ++i) {
            binomial[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j)
                binomial[i][j] = binomial[i-1][j-1] + binomial[i-1][j];

            return 1;

            long deltaL = binomial[leftIdx][r] - binomial[leftIdx-1][r];
            long sumR = binomial[rightIdx][r];
            count += search(leftVal, rightVal + deltaL * sumR, leftIdx-1, rightIdx);
        }
        if (rightIdx >= r) {
            long sumL = binomial[leftIdx][r];
            long deltaR = binomial[rightIdx][r] - binomial[rightIdx-1][r];
            count += search(leftVal + sumL * deltaR, rightVal, leftIdx, rightIdx-1);
